promotionNotAuthorized: default-on or automatic async soft-threshold compaction
always-on deterministic value pruning or provider-seam pruning
any change to CompressionArtifact v1 authority, prompt assembly order or provider call timing
any change to a frozen product default or a config-matrix lock row

retentionBoundary.note: The TF-0424 exploration surface stays shadow/diagnostic: planners and diagnostics may be unit-tested, never default-activated.

futurePromotionPreconditions: A newly authorized live-provider run scores the frozen D2 workload (or a re-frozen successor) with >=30 complete pairs and an identical model/parameter block for both arms.
Candidate fidelity is 100%, false task-completion claims are 0, next-action accuracy is >=95%, and revoked/pending/unverified facts leak 0.
Either cost or input tokens net-decrease by >=15% from provider-reported usage (never a character estimate), and first-token and wall-clock P95 stay within 1.10x of baseline.
A separate implementation spec names the applicable backend(s), the rollback path, the error fallback and the fallback when continuity context is invalid or unavailable.
The product-lock/default change is approved as its own decision; D3 or D2 evidence alone never flips a default.

rollbackAndFallbackIfEverAdopted.rollback: Disable the strategy flag and fall back to the existing manual/native compaction path; the accepted Task Ledger, CompressionArtifact and session transcript owners stay untouched.
rollbackAndFallbackIfEverAdopted.failureFallback: On missing, stale or unverifiable continuity context the session behaves as today: bounded owner refs or plain transcript continuation, with the unknown state surfaced rather than silently rewritten.
rollbackAndFallbackIfEverAdopted.dataRecovery: No new durable store is introduced by any continuity strategy; recovery keeps reading the existing session transcript, Task Ledger and CompressionArtifact owners.

explicitNonGoals: No independent Project store, cloud execution platform or permanent daemon.
No second memory, task, scheduler, compression or injection authority.
No promotion based on structural, simulated or character-estimated data.
No reopening or re-signing of the historical TF-0424 verdict.
requiresPublisherDecision: D3 must record keep-baseline/NO-GO: this evidence does not promote a continuous-compression default.
Any future promotion needs a new authorized live-provider sample set plus a separate product-lock decision.
